messages:
mira: Heads-up — staging observed streaming sessions dropping after ~40s idle when a client multiplexes streams across models. Client sees 410 + 'session_expired', auto-retries and we end up with duplicate billing and lost KV cache. Repro: open SSE to /v1/stream?models=A,B, idle for 45s, then send new tokens. Anyone seen this? 

sam: Yep. Reproduced locally. Looks like our proxy keeps an idle timeout of 30-35s and closes the connection. The client lib treats that as a terminal error and opens a fresh session without a resume token, so server spins up new KV state and billing counts again. 

cheng: We currently emit a TCP-level keepalive of 25s. Options: increase proxy idle to 90s, implement SSE 'ping' frames at 20s, or introduce resumable sessions with a server-signed resume_token. Increasing idle might waste sockets under high fan-out. 

deploy-bot: [deploy] nginx-proxy v2.3 rolled at 2025-11-12T05:03Z — config: `proxy_read_timeout 35s` 

javier: Telemetry shows a sharp bump in metric `stream.session_reconnects` and a correlating 2x multiplier in `billing.tokens_charged` for those sessions. Console currently shows two separate sessions which confuses customers during root-cause. 

elaine: My proposal: add a resumable header `X-Resume-Token` returned on session start and accepted on reconnect. Token should include model_variant id + signed session id so we can reattach KV cache and avoid double charge. Also expose `reconnect_reason` tag in logs for quicker alerting. 

mira: Agreed. Also need routing guarantees: resume must be routed to same model variant or a compatible one; else resuming can produce decode/kvcache mismatch. Could we add sticky routing by resume_token hash? 

sam: Found an edge case: if resume routes to a quantized instance with different tokenizer config, we get decode errors. So resume_token must embed `model_variant` and server must verify compatibility on resume. If incompatible, return `410` with a user-friendly prompt to re-run original request. 

cheng: I'll prototype a signed resume_token JSON: `{session_id, model_variant, kv_offset}` signed by HMAC. Will also audit billing path to ensure tokens aren't double-counted on reconnect flow. 

mira: Perfect. Can someone add a tiny unit test for resume flow and a Grafana tile for `reconnect_bill_multiplier`? I'll draft a canary rollout plan and a Console UX tweak to surface 'resumed from session X' in the stream inspector. 

javier: I'll add the telemetry tile and alert if reconnect_rate > 0.5% on prod routes. 

elaine: Quick note: update SDK to expose `onResume` callback so apps can handle partial state restores. 

sam: I'll pair with cheng on the POC. :thumbsup:
